title: Practice 10: Prepositional endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Он в ___ (шоковый) состоянии.
exercises.prompt: He's in a state of shock.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «состоянии»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You don't get eggplants from a gourd vine.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «лозе»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «очках»: prepositional plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
